name: Can I convert my garage into an ADU?

mainEntity.name: Can I convert my garage into an ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, garage conversions are specifically permitted and encouraged for ADUs, provided they meet minimum room sizes, ceiling heights, light/ventilation, and parking replacement requirements where applicable.
